name: zrndr_span_alpha_blend_565_mmx_from_tex16_alpha8
description: zRndr::SpanAlphaBlend565MmxFromTex16Alpha8 blends 16-bit texture data into a 5:6:5 destination span using per-texel alpha-map coverage.
known_limits: Guarded raw MMX under RECOIL_ENABLE_ZRNDR_SPAN_MMX_RAW_ASM now preserves the BN-proven scratch gather and four-pixel 5:6:5 alpha-map blend body; VC5SP3 byte verification with vc5_o2_ob0_md_zrndr_span_mmx_raw_asm_facs still fails with 585 unmasked mismatches after masking 132 relocation bytes and trimming 1 VC NOP byte. The expected C4799 no-EMMS warning is retained because retail has no emms in this function.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x49cbb0 validates tex16 and alpha-map sampling from g_spanActiveTexels and g_spanActiveTexAlphaMap, source index construction from texU/texV with MMX mask/step globals, destination advancement, and the scalar tail gates.

The original gathers sampled 16-bit texels and 8-bit alpha values into alloca scratch buffers, processes aligned quads with MMX 5:6:5 channel masks, then handles leftover pixels with scalar logic that skips alpha <= 3, copies alpha >= 252, and otherwise blends toward the destination.

The native smoke verifies a five-pixel span covering the packed-loop region and scalar tail, including zero-alpha packed blending, high-alpha blending, full-alpha tail copy, low-alpha tail skip, and that g_spanCurrentDst16 is not advanced by the current behavior/data-equivalent implementation.
